Helps save the restorable state of this view controller. override func encodeRestorableState(with coder: NSCoder) { coder.encode(textField.stringValue, forKey: FormViewController.formTextKey) super.encodeRestorableState(with: coder) } /// Decode state. String { textField.stringValue = restoredText } } ```
